edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from [IDENTIFY THE DISPUTE, INCLUDING ANY ACTION AND CASE NUMBER] (the “Dispute”).

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [AMOUNT AND CURRENCY TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) in cleared funds by [PAYMENT DATE TO BE AGREED], by wire transfer to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising from the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date this Agreement is executed by both parties. This release does not extend to claims unrelated to the Dispute or to rights or obligations under this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that disclosure is permitted to the extent required by law, regulation, or court order; to the party’s legal, tax, accounting, or other professional advisers who are subject to professional confidentiality duties or agree to maintain confidentiality; or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Disclosures under these exceptions shall be limited to what is required or reasonably necessary for the permitted purpose. To the extent legally permitted and reasonably practicable, a party making a compelled disclosure shall give the other party advance notice and a reasonable opportunity to seek confidential treatment. A party disclosing terms in an enforcement proceeding shall seek confidential treatment where reasonably available.
